title: pretty GRIFFIN|Plus Size V-Neck Long Lantern Sleeves A-Line Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Embrace elegance with our Plus Size V-Neck Long Lantern Sleeves A-Line Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress. The flattering V-neckline and long lantern sleeves add a touch of sophistication, while the A-line silhouette ensures a graceful fit. Crafted from lightweight chiffon, this dress offers both comfort and style, making it perfect for bridesmaids on your special day.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
